name: ResearchLoop::report
logic_name: Report only persisted research decisions and retrievable content-addressed tool, metric, and VCS evidence

test_list.description: Reopen and hash-verify every payload linked from the 20-iteration report ledger.
Persist and report the exact VCS recovery receipt payload after a child process exits during an in-flight edit.
Reopen ledger entries and retrieve the exact tool and metric payload bytes from the local CAS.

inputs.name: ledger
inputs.description: Program-bound content-addressed evidence references whose payload CIDs are revalidated on read.

output_description: Markdown report with research decisions and durable evidence IDs; it makes no source-grounding claim beyond tool, metric, and VCS records actually captured.
